pages.text: Two systems keep the world ahead of your power: the custom $(bold)Iridescent Difficulty$() mod and $(bold)Majrusz's Progressive Difficulty$(). Together they make each dimension scale and the whole world escalate as you progress.

$(bold)Iridescent Difficulty$() applies per-dimension multipliers to mob HP, damage, speed, and armor. The scaling is $(italic)time-based$() — a dimension ramps up the longer it stays loaded, then freezes at a cap. A T3 Nether mob is categorically deadlier than a T1 Overworld mob, and a base you've held for days is more dangerous than one you just entered. (The End uncaps after the Ender Dragon dies.)

$(bold)Majrusz's Progressive Difficulty$() drives elite density and three difficulty stages — $(bold)Normal$() → $(bold)Expert$() (entering the Nether) → $(bold)Master$() (the Ender Dragon kill). Higher stages bring tougher elites, larger packs, and events such as Blood Moons and Undead Army raids.

$(bold)No book.$() Both systems are tuned specifically for this pack.$(br2)$(bold)Next: read $(l:icraft:systems/champions)Progressive Difficulty$(/l) and $(l:icraft:systems/mob_toughness)Mob Toughness$(/l) for the actual multipliers before you push a new dimension.$()
